prompt: Calm, gentle instrumental background music for a cosy children's nail salon and spa scene. A soft, warm music box melody with light celesta and a delicate glockenspiel, gentle brushed felt piano touches and a warm, airy pad underneath. Relaxing and soothing, slow and unhurried, in a major key, very soft and even dynamics throughout. No drums, no percussion, no vocals, no singing, no voices, no choir, no lyrics, no sound effects, no sudden changes or swells. Even level from start to end with no build-up and no ending, so it can loop quietly underneath a page without ever drawing attention to itself.
